summary: The `WorksheetResultsEditAll` user control is a part of the HSPnet system, designed to facilitate the editing of worksheet results. It encompasses functionality related to user sessions, data editing, instructors, courses, and scheduling.
purpose: To provide a detailed editing interface for worksheet results that includes instructor assignment, schedule management, and resource handling within the HSPnet environment.

entities.name: WorksheetGroup
entities.description: Represents a group of worksheet entries being edited.

entities.name: WorksheetTotal
entities.description: Stores totals and counts related to worksheet entries, used for pagination and display.

entities.name: Timetable
entities.description: Represents scheduling information for courses and instructors.

fields.name: StartRow
fields.usage: Determines the starting row for data fetching and display.

fields.name: UserSession
fields.usage: Holds user session data, used for authentication and data access control.

fields.name: InstructorID
fields.usage: Identifies the primary instructor for a worksheet entry.

actors.name: User
actors.role: Interacts with the worksheet editing interface.

actors.name: System Administrator
actors.role: Manages system configurations and has elevated access.

actors.name: Placement Coordinator
actors.role: Handles assignment and placement of resources.

workflows.name: Edit Worksheet Results
steps: Load user session and initialize page.
Bind data to grid for editing worksheet entries.
Allow user to edit fields such as instructors, schedules, and comments.
Validate data input for consistency and correctness.
Save updates and handle navigation to next worksheet batch.

business_rules: Users with appropriate roles can edit worksheet entries.
Certain fields are disabled based on user role and data state.
validations: Ensure date fields are valid and within allowed ranges.
Instructors must be selected if required.
Check input values for shifts and times for correctness.
calculations: Calculate worksheet totals and update display accordingly.
conditions: Fields are enabled or disabled based on user role and worksheet state.
Certain changes trigger automatic recalculations or refreshes.
system_behavior: GridView controls are used for data display and editing.
JavaScript is used for dynamic UI updates and validations.
dependencies: Relies on HSPnet framework for session and data handling.
DropDownList and other UI controls required for functionality.
exceptions: Handle cases where data sources are unavailable or misconfigured.
UI should degrade gracefully with missing or partial data.
